title: Per-tenant region-intent API and analytics replication harmonizer
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Scope: Implement a per-tenant "region intent" API surfaced in Console backend and propagate that intent into the analytics pipeline so usage events are replicated only to permitted regions and converge to a consistent replica set. Goal is to provide a single source-of-truth for where a tenant's analytics may live, enable safe re-homing, and enforce quarantine rules when a tenant's allowed regions change.

Requirements:
- New Console backend API: POST/GET /tenants/{id}/region-intent (regions list + transition policy + effective_time). Must support dry-run and validate against tenant legal tags.
- Persist intent in tenant metadata store (existing tenant-metadata table) with versioning and audit fields.
- Analytics producers (event ingestion) must attach tenant-intent-vN header to events and write to primary regional topic.
- Streaming replication service will consult tenant-intent and route mirror writes only to allowed regions; when intent changes, perform controlled convergence: write gating, replay to new regions, mark old-region mirrors as read-only then tombstone after TTL.
- Console will surface a replication status widget showing per-tenant replica health, last-sync timestamps, and any quarantined events.
- Rollout plan must include canary on low-volume tenants, sampling policy, and a rollback path that sets previous intent version.

Acceptance criteria:
- API passes integration tests (validation, dry-run, audit trail).
- Producer headers present on 99% of events after rollout window.
- Replication service enforces allowlist policy and prevents writes to disallowed regions (tested via integration harness).
- Console UI shows accurate last-sync time and region list for 95% of sampled tenants.
- Documentation + Runbook created and security review completed.

Design notes / trade-offs:
- We debated storing intent on tenant control plane vs. analytics control plane. Chose control plane canonicality (tenant-metadata table) to keep permissions / billing and intent co-located and reduce cross-service consistency windows.
- Convergence strategy: snapshot-and-replay vs. streaming backfill. We chose streaming backfill with a bounded window (48h) for most tenants and snapshot fallback for >100M event tenants to avoid unbounded replay costs.
- Locking model: optimistic versioning to avoid global locking across regions; include conflict resolution guidelines in runbook.

API schema (short):
- region_intent: { allowed_regions: ["us-west-2", "eu-central-1"], transition_policy: "graceful|immediate", effective_time: "RFC3339" }

Telemetry/metrics to add:
- intent_update_rate, intent_conflict_count, replication_blocked_by_intent, replica_lag_seconds_per_region, events_with_intent_header_pct.

Docs & artifacts:
- Design spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Per-Tenant+Region+Intent+Design
- Console mockups: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xMockupsRegionIntent

Estimated infra cost impact: small during rollout, medium for large-scale backfills; include billing owner for approval.
